## Context
`reconcile_helpers.py` explicitly supports standalone file-path execution and bootstraps the shared sibling loader, but `_commit_binding_store_snapshot()` unconditionally imports `git_adapter` through the absent top-level package. `reconcile.py` loads the helper by path under flat key `reconcile_helpers`, so the supported standalone path raises `ModuleNotFoundError` before the helper can return its documented `True`/`False` result.

## Confirmed Root Cause
Commit `d9e0f0e733` replaced package-independent subprocess calls with `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter`. Runtime tracing proves the import fails at `reconcile_helpers.py:200` with no parent package and before the no-file or fail-open branches. Exact historical probes are green at d9^ and red from d9 through current HEAD. `reconcile_helpers.py:10-16,30-46`, `reconcile.py:20-36,51-58`, and `_loader.py:1-29` are the authoritative standalone contract.

## Repair Plan
- Replace the package-dependent import with the existing sibling loader using canonical key `rebar_reconciler.git_adapter` and file `git_adapter.py`.
- Preserve the helper’s current no-file `True`, successful-commit `True`, and operational-failure `False` plus diagnostic semantics.
- Preserve module identity: a package-context/pre-seeded adapter and the standalone helper must resolve the same canonical `sys.modules` object.
- Keep the change confined to the helper import seam and one held-out regression module; add no dependency and do not alter git operation behavior.

## Testing
- Add `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_reconcile_helpers_standalone_git_adapter.py` and first run it RED on the current source with `pytest -q tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_reconcile_helpers_standalone_git_adapter.py`.
- After the blind repair, rerun that held-out file GREEN, seed the exact old absolute-import defect and require it to return RED, then restore the repair and require GREEN.
- Run `pytest -q tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_commit_binding_store_failure.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_binding_retired_commit.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_reconcile_helpers_standalone_git_adapter.py`.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck` with this worktree’s `.venv/bin` first on `PATH`.
- Replicate the original fresh-process, package-free `reconcile.py` call against a temporary repository and confirm the helper returns through its documented contract.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A package-free by-path load of `reconcile.py` calls the re-exported commit helper without `ModuleNotFoundError`.
- [ ] A no-state standalone commit-back returns `True`.
- [ ] A standalone commit-back with state files reaches the canonical adapter’s git operations.
- [ ] Package-context and standalone execution reuse one `sys.modules["rebar_reconciler.git_adapter"]` module object.
- [ ] A simulated git failure returns `False` and emits the documented binding-store diagnostic.
- [ ] The focused helper/state suite passes under the stated `pytest` command.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
